title: A Deadline for the Cipher
author: Coral Whitlock
blurb: Mara Voss, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
